paragraphs: This is my diary, and my name is Tom. On Thursday, Teacher Kim asked Ben, Sam, and me for help. The Explorers had a trip to an island on Saturday. "We need three strong boys," she said. "You can carry the bags and count the children." I said yes at once. At home, Mom signed a note for me.

On Friday, Ben came to my house after school. Ben is a big fan of surfing. He showed me a video of a man on a big wave. The man could surf for a long time. "It looks easy," I said. "It is not easy," said Ben. "It is true, because I read about it." Ben told me many facts about waves. I listened for an hour, and I did not feel bored.

On Saturday, we met at the port at seven o'clock. The boat to the island was delayed. A man at the port said, "The wind is strong, so we wait for one hour." The Explorers sat on the ground and ate fruit. Leo drew the waiting boat in his notebook. A few tourists waited with us. One tourist asked me, "Do you work for the school?" At last, the boat left, and the crossing took half an hour. The sea was blue, and the waves were big. Sam counted the children three times, and all of them were there.

The island has a long white beach. Teacher Kim talked to a surf teacher near the water. The Explorers watched from the sand, and Mia took photos. Ben ran to the water at once. The sun was hot, so Teacher Kim gave us water. Leo sat in the shade and drew a shell. The surf teacher gave us a short lesson. First, we lay on a board on the sand. Then she showed us how to stand up. I tried it myself in the small waves. I fell down four times, and Ben fell down six times. On my last try, I stood up for three seconds.

We went home on the last boat in the evening. The crossing back was quiet, and many children slept. On Sunday, my arms were sore. At breakfast, I told Mom about the waves and the boat. In the afternoon, Ben came to my house. He said, "Next time, we surf all day." At dinner, I read my diary again. I am not a fan yet, but I want to try again.
text.summary: Tom writes a diary of four days. He helps the Explorers on a trip to an island, waits for a late boat, and tries to surf on the beach for the first time.
